       1                   THE REPORTER:  The attorneys participating 

       2              in the deposition acknowledge that I, [REPORTER NAME], 

       3              the court reporter, am not present with 

       4              the witness and that I will be reporting the 

       5              proceedings and administering the oath remotely.  

       6              This arrangement is pursuant to an order issued 

       7              by the Florida Supreme Court.  

       8                   The parties and their counsel consent to 

       9              this arrangement and waive any objections to 

      10              this manner of reporting.

      11                   Please indicate your agreement by stating 

      12              your name and your agreement on the record.  

      13                   [PLAINTIFF ATTORNEY]:  [PLAINTIFF ATTORNEY] on behalf of the 

      14              plaintiff, I agree.

      15                   [DEFENSE ATTORNEY]:  [DEFENSE ATTORNEY], on behalf of 

      16              the defense.  I agree.

      22         BY [DEFENSE ATTORNEY]:

      23              Q.   Good morning, sir.  My name is [DEFENSE ATTORNEY]. 

      24         I have the privilege of representing the 

      25         defendants in this case.  








                                                                      4



       1                   Have you had your deposition taken before?

       2              A.   No, I haven't.

       3              Q.   Okay.  So I'm going to try to make this as 

       4         easy as possible under what I know will be difficult 

       5         circumstances.  So let me just give you some 

       6         suggestions for the deposition, and I'm sure your 

       7         attorney has prepared you for some of this as well.  

       8                   First and foremost, if you need to take a 

       9         break for any reason whatsoever, just tell me.  We 

      10         will stop for as long as you need, okay?

      11              A.   Okay.

      12              Q.   The other thing that becomes even more 

      13         important since we're across from each other on Zoom 

      14         technology is to make sure we get an audible response 

      15         on the record.  It's very natural for people to say 

      16         "Uh-huh" or "Uh-uh" or things like that.  So if you 

      17         forget, I may ask you, "Is that a yes" or "Is that a 

      18         no."  I'm not trying to be rude.  I'm just trying to 

      19         get a record, okay, sir?

      20              A.   No problem.

      21              Q.   And, finally, if I do ask you a question 

      22         that doesn't make sense or you don't understand what 

      23         I'm asking, just please let me know and I would be 

      24         happy to reask it in a way so we're communicating, 

      25         okay?
